board.empty: Your to-dos as a board: what agents hand you and what you add for yourself. Drop one on Done and its agent picks up where it left off.

open.title: All clear — your agents have everything they need
open.description: When an agent needs a decision, your OK, a login it doesn't have or a 2FA code, it lands here instead of getting lost in a chat.

resolved.title: Nothing resolved yet
resolved.description: Requests you fix — by adding a login or 2FA code, or marking them resolved — are kept here for reference.

dismissed.title: Nothing dismissed
dismissed.description: Requests you dismiss are parked here. Reopen them any time.
